4. Specify that it is to be completed by the incident's victim or immediate eyewitness.
5. Document the immediate circumstances (what was the employee doing at the time of the initial contact) and not the activities leading up to them.
6. Capture the actual contact that caused the injury.
7. Avoid judgments attached to qualitative adjectives
8. Specify that no 'root cause' language is to be added to the accident report. A robotic, 'birth-death' description of the immediate circumstances provides an unemotional and unambiguous record.
